annotation.title_clean: Directive 2014/33/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 February 2014 on the harmonisation of the laws of the Member States relating to lifts and safety components for lifts
annotation.title_en: Directive 2014/33/EU on the harmonisation of the laws of the Member States relating to lifts and safety components for lifts
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (L 96/251)
annotation.summary_en: EU Directive 2014/33/EU recasts lift legislation, harmonising essential health and safety requirements, conformity assessment, CE marking, notified bodies and market surveillance for lifts and their safety components. It is a conventional product-safety instrument with no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Lifts and safety components must meet essential health and safety requirements in Annex I.
Installers and manufacturers must run conformity assessment, issue EU declarations of conformity and affix CE marking.
Importers and distributors have defined obligations; traceability for 10 years.
Notified bodies must meet independence and competence requirements and be notified to the Commission.
Market surveillance, safeguard procedures and penalties apply; transposition by 19 April 2016.
